title: Do concept vectors extracted from contrastive pairs encode the concept or a dataset artifact?

original_idea.body: Build standard and deliberately confounded contrast sets, extract vectors from each, test whether the vector encodes concept or nuisance, and propose a placebo-concept control.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: artifact-control protocol improves trust, but it is a methodology safeguard (gap).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Confounded vs clean sets + placebo control; training-free.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable methodological safeguard for non-lab builders.

novelty.reasoning: Spurious-direction concerns exist; standard protocol may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: A validated control protocol may be open.
